tours.section_subtitle: Experience paragliding in Ninh Binh – glide between poetic rivers and majestic limestone mountains in a land where nature and heritage meet.

experience.title: A DAY AS A LOCAL FARMER
experience.subtitle: Become a true Ninh Binh local
experience.main_desc: Experience the peaceful rural life of Ninh Binh with authentic activities:
experience.desc: Live a full day like a real Ninh Binh farmer: cycling through golden rice fields, riding buffalo, herding ducks, harvesting vegetables, and enjoying a homemade countryside meal with locals.
photo_titles: Riding buffalo like a real farmer

items.title: ANCIENT CAPITAL SPLENDOR (Standard Package)
items.desc: A basic paragliding experience offering panoramic views – ideal for first-time flyers.
highlights: Aerial view of the entire Trang An Heritage Complex.
Soar above the Ngo Dong River and Tam Coc rice fields.
Admire Hang Mua Peak from a stunning bird’s-eye perspective.

items.title: CHASING THE SUN (Sunrise / Sunset Package)
items.desc: Golden-hour flights designed for photography lovers and those seeking romantic, cinematic moments.
highlights: Capture sunrise clouds or breathtaking sunset skies over limestone mountains.
Mystical Trang An shimmering in soft morning or evening light.
Hang Mua Peak standing majestically against a sky full of colors.

items.title: LEGENDARY JOURNEY (VIP Package)
items.desc: Our longest and most premium route – offering extended flight time and the most complete panorama of Ninh Binh.
highlights: Longest and farthest flight duration available.
Admire the ancient beauty of Hoa Lu Citadel from above.
A sweeping view of all the iconic landscapes of Ninh Binh.

items.title: Cycling: Leisurely ride through small paths, breathing in the scent of rice and fresh breeze.
Buffalo Riding: Transform into a farmer and snap unique photos on a buffalo’s back.
Duck Herding: Laugh out loud while chasing a flock of ducks across the ancient capital’s waterways.

items.name: Minh
items.text: Just a few minutes in the air but the feeling is incredible. Gliding over the mountains, you truly realize how beautiful Ninh Binh is. Everyone should try it at least once.

items.name: Khanh
items.text: After flying, I only had one thought: why didn’t I do this sooner? It’s thrilling yet relaxing, and the scenery of Ninh Binh from above is absolutely mind-blowing.

items.name: Minh Ha
items.text: The moment we soared over Hang Mua was the highlight. Seeing every step and cliff I once climbed – from the sky, you realize how majestic it really is.

items.name: Hoang
items.text: Flying above the golden rice fields near Tam Coc was unreal. The endless green and gold beneath your feet is pure magic. I can’t wait to come back.

items.name: Lisa
items.text: It was soft, peaceful, and honestly quite touching. I didn’t scream, I didn’t panic. I just felt… happy.

items.name: Daniel
items.text: The pilot made me feel completely safe. I just sat back, relaxed, and took in the incredible views. Ninh Binh looks totally different from the sky.
